docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY REA, ANN AS TO DEFENDANT FOTSCH, LINDA DBA REAL NAPA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-29-2009 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED DEC-17-2008, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT FOTSCH, LINDA DBA REAL NAPA
SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JAN-29-2009 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JAN-29-2009 BY PAUL SLAVIT. APPEARANCES BY BOTH SIDES. EXHIBITS RETAINED. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506).
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-29-2009 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF REA, ANN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT FOTSCH, LINDA DBA REAL NAPA $1,750.00 PRINCIPAL, $105.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,855.00, THE COURT DETERMINES THAT THE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE PARTIES IS AN ENFORCEABLE LICENSING AGREEMENT; AND THAT DEFENDANT BREACHED THAT AGREEMENT. THE JUDGMENT REPRESENTS AN AWARD OF $350.00 PER YEAR FOR TWO YEARS FOR DEFENDANT'S USE OF IMAGES ON DEFENDANT'S WEBSITE, AND $350.00 PER YEAR, PLUS A 50% PENALTY FOR UNCREDITED USE OF PLAINTIFF'S IMAGES ON THE SANDWICH BOARD ADVERTISEMENT, FOR TWO YEARS. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT FOTSCH, LINDA DBA REAL NAPA
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED JUN-01-2009 ORDERED DESTROYED
